feature_views.structured: metadata, metric, prediction-time cost, and native measurements
feature_views.text: intervention and decision-context text composed with the structured view only by methods that declare the text modality

identity_boundary: Opaque candidate, panel, and study keys are transport metadata and are not model features.
label_boundary: Open labels only inside the active training fold; write and hash outer predictions before scoring.
modality_boundary: Unavailable code, curve, trajectory, and perceptual assets remain false rather than being inferred from summaries.
pretraining_boundary: Public intervention text may have appeared in pretrained-model data and must be reported as a contamination risk.
status: deterministic retrospective development view; no learned-model result
